programme.title: Jimmy Carr on Feminism, Parenting, and Success
programme.desc: Comedian Jimmy Carr discusses defining success without comparing yourself to others, the importance of hard work, and why he doesn't fear cancel culture. He explains his views on feminism and motherhood, why he refuses to use the term "babysitting" for parenting his own children, and how his anxieties fuel his comedy.

programme.title: Dr Julie on Triggers And Behaviour Patterns
programme.desc: Psychologist Dr Julie Smith discusses why criticism hurts so deeply, explaining how your brain needs evidence rather than mantras to build self-worth and change your critical inner voice. She explores why feedback from others can trigger old wounds and how patterns developed in childhood keep replaying in adulthood.

programme.title: Ruth Langsford On Coping With Grief & Loss
programme.desc: Broadcaster Ruth Langsford opens up about navigating divorce, grief, and the emotional reality of caring for parents with dementia. From therapy breakthroughs to the power of female friendships, Ruth shares the tools that have helped her find strength in life's most difficult moments. Fearne and Ruth compare their experiences of mum guilt, and why it's so important for young boys in particular to see the women in their life working. Ruth also reveals the sliding doors moment that led her to her TV presenting career. Content warning: this episode contains conversations about grief after suicide.

programme.title: Zayn Malik's Secret to Slow Living
programme.desc: Musician Zayn talks through the quiet lifestyle he loves in Pennsylvania: painting, being outdoors, spending time with his daughter, and staying off his phone. He explains how fatherhood has changed him, whether he's the parent he thought he would be, and what impact the new depths of emotion he feels has had on his music.

programme.title: Daisy May & Charlie Cooper Discuss Their Careers And Growing Up Working Class
programme.desc: Actors Daisy May and Charlie Cooper, siblings behind the hit show This Country, join Fearne Cotton to discuss how growing up working class shaped their work ethic, creativity, and resilience. They open up about the class divide, self-doubt in breaking into television, and the £350,000 contract clause that nearly prevented their show from happening.

programme.title: What's Going Down In Fearne's WhatsApp Groups?
programme.desc: Fearne shares what's been making her laugh, what's been frustrating her, and the small moments helping her stay grounded. From outrageous chats with lifelong friends to worrying about things outside her control, this is an honest catch-up on the highs, lows and everything in between.

programme.title: Candice Carty-Williams On Queenie Is Working On It
programme.desc: This month in the Happy Place Book Club, we've been reading Queenie Is Working On It, by Candice Carty-Williams, the follow up to 2019's Queenie. In this chat with Fearne, live from the Happy Place Festival, Candice explains why she felt it was so important to write about big topics like medical racism and fertility pressures, as well as why for her characters come first and the plot is just a side quest.

programme.title: Will Poulter on OCD and Intrusive Thoughts

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a boy called Jack. He was so poor that no girl would want to marry him. One day he went to the market to sell the cow and buy himself a suit. On his way to the market Jack met an old man, who offered him to buy a cow for a bean seed. Jack agreed and went home. There he met his mother, who realized that money was spent for nothing and threw away the seed out from the window. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales

This story teaches us a vital lesson not to be greedy and eat too much otherwise we might get into a messy situation.

programme.title: Masha's Tales

By magic, the fairy emerged and conjured her Nutcracker, who helped Cinderella to crack all the nuts very fast. The Cinderella was so happy that she took the Nutcracker with her to the ball, which took place in the royal palace. The Nutcracker helped the King to save the palace from rats and Cinderella was so thankful that she kissed him in his cheek. In this very moment the Nutcracker turned into a handsome prince! The moral of the story is that we should not judge the others by their appearance.

Jewelry is where it starts, from the traditional engagement rings of Tiffany & Co to the high-priced engagement rings worn by the hottest celebrities and the finest wedding jewelry creations of “designer to the stars” Neil Lane.You'll meet wedding cake designer Ron Ben-Israel, known for the edible bling that adorns his creations. In Atlanta, we'll meet Anne Brage who has made her mark in bridal with creating traditional wedding gowns of the highest quality. In Austin, Texas, you'll meet Rene Geneva whose unique designs are also eco-freindly.

programme.title: Bucketlist Africa
programme.desc: Africa: one of the most iconic and diverse continents. It's packed with a spectacular range of habitats and environments, and home to some of the best loved and dramatic wildlife on the planet. From the small and surprising to the enormous and entertaining, there's something for everyone's bucket list on this vast continent. From camels to giraffes, gorillas to buffalo, the sheer range of wildlife found in Africa is unbelievable. With so much to see, where would you begin your bucket list adventure?

programme.title: Stork Army: Women Fighting for the Hargila
programme.desc: In South East Asia the Greater Adjutant Stork, known locally as the Hargila, is a sight to behold. But this towering bird has seen its numbers dwindling rapidly to the point of endangerment. One woman has made it her mission to save this species from extinction. Purnima Devi Burman decided she had to take matters into her own hands, with no support from the government or financial resources, she raised a team of female environmental warriors to join her fight to save the Hargilas. She christened them ‘The Hargila Army' - and this is their story.

programme.title: Colours of Nature
programme.desc: From subtle to shocking, colour enhances the beauty of the natural world. Colour is a language to most living things, whether as a warning, camouflage or a come on. But there's more to colour than just pigment. Colours define how many animals behave, how they mate and how they inter-act with one another. For us the beautiful and varied shades of the animal kingdom form a spec-tacular kaleidoscope of colours. With all the diversity in the world, sit back and enjoy all the col-ours of the animal kingdom.

programme.title: Heroes Of The Wild Frontiers

programme.title: Wild Colombia
programme.desc: Colombia is truly unique. A magical land of wildly diverse landscapes where mirror-like wetlands fringe verdant rainforests, mangroves meander through vast grasslands and snow-capped mountain peaks emerge from misty, jungle-clad slopes. Making it home to a staggering variety of wildlife an evolutionary paradise and one of the most bio-diverse countries on earth.

programme.title: World's Rarest
programme.desc: The world is facing an urgent biodiversity crisis. Untold numbers of animals are at risk of being lost forever, with many species racing towards extinction. In this show, we try to highlight some of these incredible creatures, from the plucky pangolins to the critically endangered rhinoceroses, who live in constant fear of the poacher's bullet. Films provide a record of Earth's wonderful wildlife, but this is hopefully not an archive of what's lost, but evidence of what we should be preserving.

After the Ninja save a small fishing village, Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain but Kai promises to watch over him. When Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission... only it's a trap from a GHOST who's escaped the Cursed Realm. When the Ninja's powers mysteriously disappear, they return to the Tea Farm and are attacked by Lloyd, who is possessed by the spirit of Moro, the Master of Wind! After a harrowing escape on the Bounty, Wu tells the Ninja they weren't his first pupils!

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot. Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot. Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword.

programme.desc: Heddiw, bydd Huw yn ymuno â Chlwb Achub Bywyd Llanilltud Fawr; cwrddwn â Hollie a Heidi a'u ffrindiau pigog; a bydd Meleri a Ieuan yn chwilio am pob math o adar yn Llanelli. Fresh air fun!

programme.title: Pentre Papur Pop
programme.desc: Ar yr antur popwych heddiw mae'r ffrindiau yn dathlu dydd Santes Dwynwen! On today's poptastic adventure, the friends are celebrating Saint Dwynwen's Day!

programme.title: Help Llaw
programme.desc: Yn y bwyty mae Alys a Jez yn brysur yn coginio, ond wedi colli'r allwedd i'r drws, beth am y cwsmeriaid? Alys and Jez cook lunch but have lost the front door keys so customers can't come in!

programme.title: Blwi
programme.desc: Mae Blwi a Bingo'n dadlau dros y seiloffon hud,sydd â phwerau i rewi Dad a chael rheolaeth llwyr drosto. Blwi and Bingo squabble over the magic xylophone, that has the power to freeze Dad.

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach Ni
programme.desc: Heddiw, awn ar antur i'r Swistir i weld mynyddoedd yr alpau, dinas Zurich, a'r brifddinas Bern, yn ogystal â dysgu am bethau enwog o'r wlad fel yr alphorn. We take a trip to Switzerland!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: A fydd defaid Jacson yn difetha gwyl flodau Preston cyn i Mojo a Bo eu corlannu? Jackson's sheep will ruin Preston's flower festival unless Mojo and Bo can round them up!

programme.title: Ne-wff-ion
programme.desc: Mae Lwsi'n ymweld â theulu sy'n addysgu eu plant gartre, a'r gwersi yn cynnwys dysgu am wenyn, mêl, a gwneud cloc haul. On Newffion today Lwsi visits a family that home-teach their children.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Mae gan Pablo ei ffordd ei hun o weld y byd, a heddiw mae pawb wedi mynd i'r sw. The zoo is full of fun, and there's also a very special surprise awaiting everyone.

programme.title: Sigldigwt
programme.desc: Mae Gwesty Sigldigwt ar agor! Heddiw cawn gwrdd â sawl cath fach a Delor a'i asynnod. Today we meet some cute kittens and Delor and her donkeys.

programme.title: Twm Twrch
programme.desc: Pan nad yw Mishmosh yn gallu cystadlu yng nghystadleuaeth, rhaid i Twm a Dorti wisgo i fyny a chystadlu yn ei le. Twm and Dorti must dress up and compete in the greatest inventor comp.

programme.title: Annibendod
programme.desc: Mae Anni a Lili yn cael trafferth efo'r seinydd clyfar ac yn archebu pethau annisgwyl wrth geisio holi am gerddoriaeth. Anni and LIli are having trouble with the smart speaker.

programme.title: Ger a Gu
programme.desc: Mae Ger a Gu yn gallu arogli pîn-afalau ym mhobman ym Mhorthoer ond 'dy'n nhw methu dod o hyd iddyn nhw! Ger & Gu can smell pineapples everywhere in Porthoer, but there are none to be seen.

programme.title: Dal Dy Ddannedd
programme.desc: Timau o Ysgol Ifor Hael sy'n ymuno â Pwdryn a Melys i chwarae llond trol o gemau lliwgar! The challenge is to collect as many clean teeth as possible and win the Dani Dant Trophy!

programme.title: New: Penblwyddi Cyw
programme.desc: Cyfle i edrych 'nôl dros rai o gyfarchion pen-blwydd yr wythnos. A look back at some of this week's birthday greetings.

programme.title: Mynyddoedd y Byd
programme.desc: Jason Mohammad sy'n crwydro'r Swistir mewn car, trên, lifft-sgïo a hofrennydd i weld effaith y byd cyfoes ar yr Alpau. Jason Mohammad learns how the contemporary world impacts on the Alps.

programme.title: Hydref Gwyllt Iolo
programme.desc: Rhan olaf taith Iolo o fywyd gwyllt yr hydref, a chrwydrwn afonydd, coedlannau collddail a thir gwlyb yng Ngwm Rheidol, Cors Caron a Llynnoedd Cosmeston. Last part of Iolo's autumnal tour.

programme.title: Y Deis
programme.desc: Cwis llawn gwybodaeth, strategaeth a bach o lwc! Yn cystadlu am y Jacpot mae timau o Faesteg, Aberystwyth/Blaenau Ffestiniog a Cheredigion. Quiz that combines knowledge, strategy and luck!

programme.title: Dechrau Canu Dechrau Canmol
programme.desc: Lowri Morgan sydd yn Nheml Shree Swaminarayan yng Nghaerdydd yn profi llawenydd Gwyl Diwali. Lowri Morgan is in Shree Swaminarayan Temple in Cardiff experiencing the joy of Diwali Festival.

programme.title: Cegin Clwyd Bryn Williams
programme.desc: Mae Bryn yn coginio stecen, tatws a madarch ar gyfer Rhodri, fferm Brynllech Uchaf, Llanuwchllyn. Bryn barbeques a t-bone steak, potato and mushroom for Rhodri from Brynllech Uchaf.

programme.title: Cerys Matthews: Y Goeden Faled
programme.desc: Ar drywydd hanes y caneuon gwerin Wrth fynd efo Deio i Dywyn a Bugeilio'r Gwenith Gwyn. Cerys Matthews explores the history of two Welsh folk songs and performs her own arrangement of each.

programme.title: Y Fets
programme.desc: Y tro hyn: Mae'n rhaid i'r tim fod yn hynod ofalus wrth drin ci peryglus dros ben sydd angen triniaeth i dynnu tyfiant cas. The practice experiences some effects of the war in Ukraine.

programme.title: Stori'r Iaith - Guto Harri
programme.desc: Guto Harri sy'n mynd ar daith bersonol i olrhain stori'r iaith Gymraeg ac mae'n cwrdd â theulu ei arwr, David Lloyd George. Guto Harri meets descendants of his hero, David Lloyd George.

programme.title: Llond Bol o Japan
programme.desc: Mae Chris Flambaster Roberts yn teithio yn Japan, yn gwledda ar tofu yn Kyoto ac yn teithio i'r De i fwyta bwyd stryd blasus yn Osaka. Chris eats a tofu feast and tasty street food in Osaka.

programme.title: Trefi Gwyllt Iolo
programme.desc: Mae Iolo yn darganfod miloedd o adar yn hedfan i'r dref i dreulio'r nos. Iolo finds thousands of birds flying to town to spend the night from wagtails and jackdaws to thrushes and waxwings.

programme.title: Cyfrinachau'r Great Escape
programme.desc: Mae mab a merch yn dilyn ôl traed eu tad, carcharor rhyfel yn yr Ail Ryfel Byd, ac yn datgelu gwybodaeth newydd am y ffilm. WWII prisoner's tale reveals new Great Escape facts.

programme.title: Ffermio
programme.desc: Cyfres sy'n edrych ar y byd amaeth, yn cynnwys rai o bynciau llosg y diwydiant. A series exploring the world of agriculture across Wales.

programme.title: New: Pobol y Cwm Omnibws
programme.desc: Cipolwg yn ôl dros ddigwyddiadau'r wythnos yng Nghwmderi. Omnibus edition looking back at the events in Cwmderi over the past week. With on-screen English subtitles.

programme.title: Newyddion S4C
programme.desc: Newyddion S4C a'r Tywydd. S4C News and Weather.

programme.title: New: Dechrau Canu Dechrau Canmol
programme.desc: Nia Roberts sy'n cyflwyno gwledd o emynau o wasanaeth Moliant y Maes yn y Sioe Frenhinol ym mis Gorffennaf. Nia Roberts presents a feast of hymns from The Royal Welsh showground in July.

programme.title: New: Cyrraedd Cymru
programme.desc: Seren sy'n datgelu straeon mudo o Ddwyrain Ewrop, gan ddathlu'r cymunedau sy'n siapio Cymru. Seren uncovers Eastern European migration stories, celebrating the communities that shape Wales.

programme.title: Glyndwr: Gobaith a Gwaed
programme.desc: Drama-ddogfen emosiynol am Glyndwr, o frwydro Coron Lloegr i'w ddiflaniad dirgel. Emotional docudrama about Glyndwr, from his rebellion against the English to his mysterious disappearance.

programme.title: Y Lein: Streic Friction Dynamics
programme.desc: Dogfen am un o'r anghydfodau diwydiannol hiraf yn hanes Prydain: Streic ffatri Friction Dynamics, Caernarfon. Documentary about the Friction Dynamics factory strike, near Caernarfon.

programme.title: Prosiect Pum Mil
programme.desc: Gyda chyllid o ddim ond £5000, mae'r criw yn trawsnewid Neuadd Santes Helen, Penisarwaun. With funding of just £5000, the team transform St. Helen's Hall, Penisarwaun.
